name: MailerLite
description: Subscribers, groups and campaigns in your MailerLite account.
long_description:
MailerLite's hosted server. It reads subscribers and groups, looks at campaign statistics, and drafts a campaign.

A campaign goes to a list of real people, so sending one is confirmed every time.

auth.instructions: Sign in to MailerLite in your browser; the server registers Gantry on the spot.

risk.notes: Reaches your subscriber lists. Sending a campaign mails real people and is confirmed every time.
